# PM Review - MStar US Equity

## Executive Summary

MStar US Equity 2026-05-31: full target and benchmark coverage (2/2 rows matched [1]); 0 triggers fired; 2 approved exceptions in force (EM EQ residual, USD Cash); US EQ context shows Q1 2026 blended EPS growth 28.6% vs. 13.1% quarter-start estimate, led by Comm Services, with Energy the only sector declining [2].

## Key Positioning Tensions

### 1. US EQ

Q1 2026 blended S&P 500 EPS growth of 28.6% beat the 13.1% quarter-start estimate; Communication Services led all sectors (48.9%) driven by Alphabet, Amazon, and Meta; Energy is the sole sector with a declining EPS growth rate (0.6% vs. 8.2%) [2] [3]; US EQ mapped as broad-market-beta, comparison group us_equity_broad [4]; individual ACID exposure rows are compacted at this snapshot so active/target/benchmark weight delta is not resolvable.

**PM Takeaway:** The 28.6% blended earnings beat is heavily concentrated in Comm Services mega-caps, so the aggregate US EQ signal may overstate broad market health if sector weights are skewed toward Energy or other EPS laggards [2].

**What Would Change the View:** Uncompacted ACID-level sector exposure rows at the next snapshot, or a broadening of EPS beats beyond mega-cap Comm Services, would sharpen or soften this read [2].
